title: Vendor Access Request — Kessler Controls (F-4)

fields.subject: FW: Vendor Access Request — Kessler Controls (F-4) — Required for PLC-02 Re-image
fields.note: Kessler Controls has confirmed the spare PLC-02 (revision 3.2) is on-site and ready for re-image. They’ve also confirmed that remote access to the device is blocked until a signed access request (Form F-4) is uploaded and approved via their vendor portal. The request must be signed by the Director of Water Operations or the City Manager. I’ve attached the form and the vendor’s compliance policy. No remote session can begin without it. The process is governed by C1 (RACI) and C16 (Vendor Access Policy).
fields.signature:
Priya Nandakumar
SCADA / IT Security Manager

original.subject: Re: Remote Access Request for PLC-02 — Spare Unit on-Site
original.body:
Hi Priya,

Confirmed: the spare PLC-02 (revision 3.2) is on-site at the RWTP and available for re-image. We can begin remote support only after you upload and sign the Kessler Controls Vendor Access Form (F-4) via our secure portal.

Per our policy (Section 6.2, C1), remote access cannot be initiated without a signed request. The portal will not accept an unsigned form or a request from an unapproved signatory.

The form must be signed by the Director of Water Operations (Denise Albrecht) or the City Manager (Gloria Tennant). Please route through the City Manager’s office and confirm once signed.

We will not proceed until the form is uploaded and verified. No exceptions.

Regards,

Jared Molina
Kessler Controls, Support Engineer
(555) 039-4411
support@kesslercontrols.com

instructorNote: This inject creates a critical technical hurdle: the team must initiate a formal, high-level approval process to allow vendor access. The IT team must escalate to the City Manager and Incident Commander immediately. Watch for delays due to bureaucratic handoffs.
